title: Task filtering: visual and technical verification

steps.title: Filter tasks and retain edits
steps.rationale: Check the visible task list, then reload to verify browser-local persistence.
edgeCases: The fixture contains synthetic tasks only.
UI edits are stored in localStorage, not in the API or database fixture.

steps.title: Empty results and a long title on mobile
steps.rationale: Use a fresh browser context at 390px width to check the empty filtered view and a long task title.
edgeCases: A fresh context starts from the three seeded tasks.
Screenshots document layout; automated text checks do not establish overall accessibility.

actions.value: Review the release checklist with the client and verify every mobile acceptance criterion

steps.title: Inspect the seeded API response
steps.rationale: Check HTTP success and one seeded record independently of the browser.
edgeCases: This read-only endpoint returns the seed, not browser-local edits.

steps.title: Assert the filtering rules
steps.rationale: Run the same filter function used by the UI against seeded database rows, including empty and invalid-filter inputs.
stdoutIncludes: PASS: all, open, done, empty, and invalid-filter assertions

steps.title: Snapshot read-only database rows
steps.rationale: Query an isolated SQLite fixture with an explicit column list, stable ordering, and a row limit.
edgeCases: SQLite stores completion as 0/1; the browser uses booleans.

steps.title: Check the generated verification artifact
steps.rationale: Capture the actual report produced by the CLI check, then validate its result fields.

steps.title: Inspect the filtering implementation
steps.rationale: Compare the implemented filter against the deliberately incomplete baseline in an isolated Git fixture.
edgeCases: A diff records code state; it does not establish runtime correctness.
